entrypoint_notes: SKILL.md is a new Vitalis-bound knowledge-only entrypoint, not a copy of the upstream orchestrator. Source Markdown was read as untrusted reference data; no upstream code was executed. Research links and upstream dates are preserved as attribution, not independently verified findings.

safety-boundaries.adaptation_notes: Condensed safety education; red flags precede tools. Applicability is not assumed. No diagnosis or individual progression authority.

evidence-and-uncertainty.adaptation_notes: Retained evidence hierarchy and five upstream public source links; no claim of independent medical verification or personalized evidence engine.

training-principles.adaptation_notes: Condensed domains, general population activity guidance, technique and progression concepts. Explicit hypothetical example only. Excluded programming lines 21–33 compiler contracts, individual schedules, metric derivation and prescriptions.

technique-and-session-education.adaptation_notes: Retained warm-up, short cues, rest and substitution concepts. Removed historical-load calculations, automatic set adjustments and record writing; rest intervals are hypothetical only.

nutrition-education.adaptation_notes: Retained plate, habit and eating-relationship education. Removed personal calorie/protein calculation, trend inference and dietary prescriptions; food example is explicitly hypothetical.

recovery-and-discomfort.adaptation_notes: Retained sleep, recovery and help-seeking education. Removed traffic-light classification, readiness scoring, individual percentage deloads and automatic records.
